name: 奥拉夫
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:676
gear: 共鸣（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜网岛最好的渔人、会收潮网叉术，页上写他不会打仗；岛主敲门那一回拿梭子守门，只在渔衣外头加一件岛上见得到的海兽鳞皮背心和一杆短鱼叉，写 battle_pose
who: Olaf, a human net-mender of the net-island, about seventy, the best mender on the island and childless all his life; seventeen years ago he prised open a drifting chest and took in the mother and baby inside: about 170 cm, lean and wiry, a little bowed at the shoulders, quick big-knuckled hands. Short-cropped white hair thinning at the crown, white stubble, bushy white eyebrows. Small deep-set eyes of a clear sea blue, narrowed from a lifetime of counting net meshes. A weathered, sea-wind-reddened, deeply lined face. Few words, quick hands, afraid of the island lord all his life and still standing his ground. No jewellery, no glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old fisherman's lined face of about seventy, narrowed small sea-blue eyes with deep crow's feet, bushy white eyebrows, white stubble, a long thin nose reddened by the sea wind, thin lips; skin shadows a warm ruddy pink.
build: 170 cm, lean and wiry: narrow, slightly bowed shoulders, ropy forearms, big-knuckled hands.
palette: white hair, clear sea blue, faded sail-grey hemp, seal-skin brown, net-rope straw
casual: His fisher clothes: a faded hemp short tunic, a sleeveless seal-skin vest over it, an old length of net rope tied round the waist as a belt, rolled hemp trousers, plaited sea-grass shoes; a fish-bone needle held between his teeth at the corner of the mouth; a half-mended net draped over his left forearm and a wooden mending shuttle in his right hand. He stands slightly stooped, intent on the mesh.
private: At home in the evening: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, a knitted grey wool cap, hemp trousers, bare feet; a coil of fresh net cord over one shoulder; he runs his thumb along a strand, counting meshes. A quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Standing in the doorway against the island lord, in an old fisherman's best: the hemp tunic under a vest of grey sea-serpent scale-hide that sheds water with a faint sea-green sheen, the net-rope belt cinched tight, a fishing net knotted across the chest, leather wrist guards, sea-grass shoes. He grips the heavy wooden mending shuttle in his right hand like a club and holds a short barbed fish-spear of bone and driftwood across his body in the left. Afraid and not moving, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, planted in a doorway with the shoulders hunched but squared, the wooden mending shuttle gripped like a club in one hand and a short fish-spear held across the body in the other, frightened but stubborn, the mouth closed.
formal: At the island lord's feast: a clean undyed linen shirt laced at the throat, a dark blue wool tunic belted with a newly plaited net-rope belt, a short grey wool cloak pinned with a bone pin, clean sea-grass shoes; he holds his knitted cap in both hands. An awkward, stiff look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the narrowed sea-blue eyes looking at the viewer over a strand of net, the fish-bone needle at the corner of the mouth. Bright grey sea light from one side and sunlight dappled through net meshes across his face. Foreground blur: fishing net and a wooden shuttle.

name: 沃尔夫里克
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:689
gear: 灵格（估）｜富｜照常｜3档｜不是斩兽做王的人，是有一半的船、收一半的鱼的岛主，估灵格；岛上最富，家境加一档，穿得起整张海兽皮的战袍、带核的斧
who: Wolfric, a human, lord of the net-island, about forty-eight, who owns half the boats and buys half the catch; Einar's father: about 186 cm, big and heavy, a barrel chest and a thick neck, gone fleshy but still strong. Brassy golden hair worn to the shoulders and combed back, thinning at the temples, and a full brass-gold beard braided into two thick plaits tied with gold rings. Small, bright hazel eyes that laugh loudest when he is counting. A ruddy, broad, once-handsome face. A heavy twisted gold arm ring on the right upper arm (on the viewer's left when they face us). He laughs louder than he talks, gives gifts freely and holds grudges longer. No glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, ruddy man's face of about forty-eight, small bright hazel eyes with laugh lines, thick brass-gold eyebrows, a big nose, a wide mouth framed by a full brass-gold beard braided into two plaits; skin shadows a warm ruddy pink.
build: 186 cm, big and heavy: broad shoulders, a barrel chest and a thickening middle, heavy arms.
palette: brass gold, deep indigo, hazel, bright gold, white fine linen, sea-serpent blue-green
casual: His lord's clothes: a long deep-indigo wool cloak pinned on the left shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us) with a large gold brooch cast as a fish biting its own tail, over a fine white linen robe to the knee with long fitted sleeves, a wide leather belt with a gold buckle, dark wool trousers and soft leather boots; a big horn drinking cup rimmed with silver raised in his right hand. He laughs loudly, the chest thrown out.
private: At ease in his own house: the cloak off, a loose dyed-blue wool tunic with the sleeves pushed up, the belt loosened, soft house shoes, the beard plaits a little loose; he holds a heel of bread in one hand and a strip of smoked fish in the other, chewing and grinning.
battle: Ready to put down trouble in his own hall, in gear only the richest man on the island could buy: a fitted war-coat cut from one whole sea-serpent hide, its blue-green scales overlapping like plates and giving off a faint wet glow; over it the indigo cloak pinned back with the gold fish brooch; a bronze cap-helmet with a gold band; leather vambraces studded with small sea-shell discs that glint. In his right hand a heavy bearded axe with a whalebone haft, a small water-core set below the blade breathing a thin cold mist along the edge. A broad, mocking grin, the feet planted wide.
formal: Host of the nine-night wedding feast: a rich deep-indigo wool cloak lined with seal fur and pinned with the gold fish brooch, a pale linen robe trimmed with gold-thread borders, a belt of linked bronze plates, fresh gold rings tied on the beard plaits, polished boots; he raises the silver-rimmed horn cup high in his right hand in a toast. A booming laugh.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the face large, the small hazel eyes looking down at the viewer, laughing with the mouth open in a toast. Warm, smoky torchlight of a long hall from one side, gold glinting on the brooch and the beard rings. Foreground blur: the silver-rimmed horn cup raised toward the lens and a few drifting sparks.

name: 白礁国的老王
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:702
gear: 极境（估）｜富（王家）｜照常｜3档｜年轻时斩过潮鳞蛇的群首、靠斩兽戴上冠，估极境；王家，极境以上家境至多加一档，可他身上是年轻时那一套蛇皮甲，冠上的核早暗了，人也老了，定三档
who: The old king of White Reef, a human king by the sea, about seventy, Danae's father; as a young man he killed the lord of the tide-scaled serpents: about 178 cm, tall but gone thin and slack, the shoulders hunched in on themselves. Thin white hair to the shoulders, a trimmed white beard. Faded slate-blue eyes, the same storm colour as his daughter's paled with age, ringed with dark sleepless shadows; he glances at every doorway. He sleeps with a whole room of lamps burning. A fearful, suspicious, still-proud air. No glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gaunt old man's face of about seventy, deep-set faded slate-blue eyes with dark shadows beneath, heavy lines across the forehead and from the nose to the mouth, thin white eyebrows, a straight proud nose, a trimmed white beard, thin tight lips; skin shadows a cool pale pink.
build: 178 cm, tall and gone thin: narrow, hunched shoulders, a hollow chest, long bony hands.
palette: faded slate blue, sea-foam white, old gold, dull dark sea-green, reef-stone grey
casual: His king's clothes: a long sea-foam white wool robe to the ankles closing down the front with gold buttons, fitted sleeves, a heavy deep sea-blue cloak pinned at both shoulders with gold discs, a belt of linked gold plates, soft leather shoes; on his head a narrow crown of old gold set with a single sea-green beast core from the serpent he killed, the core long gone dull and dark. In his left hand a small lit clay oil lamp. He stands stiffly, glancing sideways.
private: At night in his chambers: a long-sleeved white linen nightshirt to the ankles, a thick grey wool over-robe wrapped tight and belted, felt slippers, no crown; he holds up a lit clay oil lamp in each hand, peering into the dark. A frightened, sleepless look.
battle: In the war gear of his youth, kept all these years and now too big for him: a long coat of tide-scaled serpent hide, its dark sea-green scales overlapping like plates, the shine faded to a faint watery gleam along the edges; the serpent's head-crest worked into a hooded mantle over the shoulders; bronze vambraces engraved with waves; the narrow gold crown with its dark core. He raises a long straight bronze-hilted sword, NOT a curved sword, its blade ground from one pale serpent fang, uncertainly in his right hand. Tense and wary, the mouth tight.
formal: In full regalia at his court: a long sea-foam white robe embroidered at the hem with gold waves, a mantle of deep sea-blue wool lined with white seal fur and pinned with two gold discs, the gold crown with its dark sea-green core, a tall staff of white reef coral capped with gold in his right hand. He stands upright and proud, the chin raised.
art: A portrait, the face turned three-quarters, the faded slate-blue eyes glancing sidelong at the viewer, haunted and suspicious, the mouth tight. Many small warm oil-lamp flames surround him in the dark and light his face from several sides at once. Foreground blur: a burning clay lamp and a drift of lamp smoke.

name: 赶驴的老妇人
src: 月银纪史诗/第二歌_镜中石瞳.md:715
gear: 神（风之璐璐薇行走人世，扮老妇人）｜—｜不打仗｜不出｜用户 11-07 定神行走人世不出战斗服，cells 只写三套；battle 一句照写备着，不出图
who: An old woman driving a donkey along the coast road, older than anyone can guess: about 168 cm even with a slight stoop, long-limbed and spare, light on her feet for her age. Grey hair wrapped in a grey cloth kerchief, a few strands blowing loose. A thin face carved deep by the sea wind, crow's feet that crinkle when she laughs. Bright, sharp emerald-green eyes with the wind in them, laughing and a little teasing. Two grey feathers tucked at the front of her clothes. An unhurried, amused air; when her firewood spills she sits and watches the sea instead of picking it up. No jewellery.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old woman's lean, deeply wind-lined face, long laugh lines and crow's feet, bright sharp emerald-green eyes that crinkle with amusement, thin grey eyebrows, a long straight nose, a wide thin mouth in a sly smile; skin shadows a soft warm pink.
build: 168 cm with a slight stoop, spare and long-limbed, thin wiry arms.
palette: wind grey, weathered undyed wool, emerald green, feather grey, a little faded sky blue
casual: Her road clothes: a long grey wool dress worn inside out, the seams showing and the grey side turned outward, long fitted sleeves, a short grey wool shawl crossed over the chest, a grey cloth kerchief over the hair, sturdy old leather shoes; two grey feathers pinned at the breast of the dress; a bundle of firewood tied with cord under one arm and a long bone needle threaded with grey thread in the other hand. She stands with a sly, laughing look.
private: Off the road for a while: the kerchief pushed back off the grey hair, the inside-out grey dress, the shawl round her shoulders; she holds a pair of plaited grass shoes in one hand and the bone needle in the other, about to stitch a grey feather into a heel. Amused and unhurried.
battle: She does not fight: standing on the slope road with the shawl blowing, one arm raised and two grey feathers lifting off her open palm into a sudden gust, the bone needle in the other hand. A sly smile.
formal: On a feast day, when she bothers to look tidy: a long faded sky-blue wool dress worn the right way round, closing down the front with wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a clean white linen kerchief, a grey wool shawl pinned with a bone pin with two grey feathers tucked into it. She stands straight for once, laughing.
art: A portrait, the face turned three-quarters into a sea wind, the emerald eyes laughing at the viewer, a sly closed-mouth smile. Bright, cool sea light from one side; the kerchief and a few grey strands blown back. Foreground blur: two grey feathers whirling in the wind and the long ear of a donkey at the edge of the frame.
